rows.why: He said za3amt (letters swapped) for 3azamt 'I invited'; Amal prompted him to try again then gave عزمت, and at 04:05 he himself names it as the word she corrected (same shape as the 09-26 دبا/بدا wrong-form ruling, not S4).
Amal asked كيف الجو عندكم اليوم at ~2pm and he answered 'tonight' (الليلة); best reading is he meant today (اليوم); could also be the engine - she let it pass.
'a video on YouTube' takes 3ala, he used la-; Amal let it pass (best reading, no signal).
rows.english: I watched a video on YouTube

rows.why: He stretched the verb to salaa7to (wrong shape of salla7t 'I fixed it'); Amal recast صلحته and he repeated his form again at 08:12 (one row); borderline F2 vowel length.
Sheet: 'i call | Ana barenn (3ala)' - rann takes 3ala, he used la-; also the engineer he means is a specific one so el- is missing; Amal was busy with the electricity word and let it pass.

rows.medi_said: Is it را-- راكي؟ What, What was electricity?
rows.why: He could not retrieve 'electricity' (tried raaki then asked); Amal supplied كهربا - a didn't-know (sheet: electricity | Kahraba | كهربا).

rows.medi_said: مهندس-- Do you guys say مهندس كهرباء؟
rows.why: Job-title idafa: el- goes on the second word (muhandes el-kahraba); he offered it without el- and framed it as 'do you say', Amal recast with el-.

rows.medi_said: كراجي. See, This is a new word.
rows.why: He dropped a syllable of the word she had just given (karaaji for kahrabji); she recast it syllable by syllable; also said كرهبجي at 09:30 (swapped letters).

rows.medi_said: ما، ما يكون، كهربجي، هو مهندس
rows.why: To say 'he is not an engineer, he is an electrician' the noun is negated with mish and no 'to be' verb; he built ma ykoon; Amal let it pass (best reading of a halting turn).
rows.english: He is not an engineer, he is an electrician

rows.medi_said: صـ صلح، صلحني شوي. ... صلح لي, helps to me, شوي.
rows.amal_said: صلحني would be he fixed me. Like you, you were who's being fixed. ... Fixed for me، صلح لي.
rows.why: 'for me' rides on the preposition la- (salla7-li), not on the verb as its object (salla7ni = he fixed ME); Amal explained the difference out loud.
rows.english: he fixed (it) for me / helped me a bit

rows.medi_said: صلح لي, helps to me, شوي.
rows.amal_said: You said صلح which is fix. You did wha-- did you wanna say he helped me? ... ساعدني.
rows.why: He used salla7 (fix) meaning 'he helped me'; Amal asked whether he meant help and he produced ساعدني (sheet: help | Saa3ed | ساعد).

rows.medi_said: بلوزة، um, ورداني لأول مرة معك
rows.amal_said: بدائية. (engine; she said وردية) ... صح لأول مرة.
rows.why: blooze is feminine so the colour adjective needs -e; he said the masculine, she recast the feminine (engine wrote بدائية) and he took it: 'وردانية that's right'. Her sheet word for pink is zahri but she accepted wardi.
rows.english: a pink blouse, for the first time with you

rows.why: Wrong shape of dallait 'I stayed' (sheet: i stayed/kept | Ana dallait | أنا ضليت); Amal did not recognise it ('what?') and gave ضليت, he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: اه، this is take على بيتي.
rows.why: 'at home' is fi / bi, he used 3ala; Amal prompted 'bi or fi?' and he fixed to في بيتي.
'one word' puts wa7de after the noun like an adjective; he put it in front (English order), Amal recast كلمة وحدة.

rows.medi_said: بس كلمة-- بس فعل، اه، تنين،
rows.amal_said: أههم بس فعلاً. (engine; she said فعلين)
rows.why: Two takes the dual form fe3lain, not fe3el + tnain; Amal gave the dual and he repeated فعلين at 13:46.
She asked for 'you (f) got annoyed with me'; he stalled and she supplied the past form انزعجتي - a didn't-know, not a slip.

rows.medi_said: نز، نزعجتي، معي انزعجتي، ... مع، معي
rows.amal_said: ليش ما؟ ... You were annoyed with me. You got annoyed with. Yes. So.
rows.why: 'annoyed with someone' takes min (she had just said so at 14:35); he used ma3i, she prompted, he fixed to مني at 16:10/16:22 and she said Perfect.
He built 'one more' word for word with aktar; Levantine says kaman wa7ad (sheet: one more time | Kaman marra); Amal gave it and he repeated.
Addressing a woman the adjective needs -e; she prompted 'inti or inta?' and he fixed: 'إنتي right? So مزعوجة'.
Plural subject 'many things' needs the plural verb byez3ejooni; he used a singular form; Amal recast twice (he repeated the slip at 20:29, she fixed again at 20:32 - one row).
rows.english: Many things annoy me these days

rows.why: Plural of yoam is ayyaam; he said el-ayoom, Amal recast أيام and he took it ('I even wrote أيام').

rows.medi_said: إنتي متأكدة إلي إنتو ما ازعج، از- ازعجتو.
rows.why: 'sure THAT you didn't...' is the connector enno, not illi (illi = the one who); Amal asked why illi and said إنو مش اللي.
rows.english: Are you sure that you (pl) didn't annoy him?

rows.why: 'you (pl) annoyed HIM' needs the object ending -o on the verb; he left it off and Amal only fixed the illi/enno piece.

rows.medi_said: إذا ما أشوفك... Is it تكوني or just مبسوطة?
rows.amal_said: بس مبسوطة إذا ما بشوف هيك.
rows.why: iza KEEPS the b- on the verb; he dropped it (ashoofak); Amal recast with بشوف and he took it: 'إذا ما بشوفك مبسوطة' (22:31). His تكوني question is a question, not a slip.
rows.english: I get annoyed if I don't see you happy

rows.why: 'don't be annoyed' is ma + the you-form; he produced a bare command inz3aji; Amal prompted 'So don't be' and he fixed to ما تنزعج / ما تنزعجي.
After mish 2asdhom ('it wasn't their intention to') the verb is bare - ydaay2ooki, no b-; he kept the b- (and said t for d/q, S4); Amal recast يدايقوكي.
rows.english: They didn't mean to upset you

rows.medi_said: So I add is بزيء، بزياد،
rows.why: Wrong shape of bazeed 'I add' (sheet: i add | Bazeed | بزيد); Amal recast and he repeated بزيد.

rows.medi_said: and to remove is uh, شو الفعل؟
rows.why: He asked for the verb 'remove'; Amal supplied بقيم (sheet: i remove / take away | Ba2eem | بقيم) - a didn't-know.

rows.medi_said: الـ أول الـ فعل، الـ أول الكلمة.
rows.why: 'the beginning of the verb' is awal el-fe3el - no el- before awal (A13 / idafa); he put el- on both words; Amal had asked من وين and only said Mm.
rows.english: (I remove the ma) from the beginning of the verb

rows.why: He built ba5sar (a different word, 'I lose') for bakser 'I break'; Amal said 'close' and gave بكسر; could be read as an S4 letter slip but she voiced the fix.
Letters swapped: sakkarti (you closed) for kasarti (you broke); Amal recast and he repeated كسرتي twice.
Plain present 'they break' needs the b-: byeksru; he gave the bare yeksru in the conjugation run and Amal said 'Nice' / moved on.
'you keep breaking' = btdalli btkesri; after badall the second verb keeps its bt- and he said a bare kesri three times; Amal recast بتكسري and said she didn't hear the t; he fixed at 33:31.

rows.medi_said: Is it يسكر and يسكري؟ اسكرو؟ إسكر.
rows.amal_said: The K is before the S.
rows.why: Letters swapped again (eskor = close) for the command 'break' (eksor); Amal named it: 'The K is before the S', he fixed to اكسري، اكسروا.

rows.amal_said: So it's either inكسر or انكسر.
rows.why: Past of the n- verb 'it got broken' is inkasar; he offered a bare nkasar as a question, she gave انكسر and he took it; framed as a question so low confidence (F3 is not scored on its own).

rows.amal_said: أشياءي نوع الإل. (engine; she said أشيائي بدون الـ)
rows.why: A noun carrying a possessive ending never also takes el-; Amal said 'ashyaa2i without el-' and he fixed: 'كل أشيائي'.
'his cups' needs the plural kaasaat + o; he said the singular kaasto; Amal recast and he said 'كاساته، of course'.
kaase is feminine so the verb needs -at (inkasarat); he used the masculine; Amal recast and he saw it: 'Oh, cause it's female'.

rows.amal_said: شو بدم كمان مرة؟ ... صح، بس order. Word or letters order.
rows.why: Letters swapped a third time (insakarat for inkasarat); Amal asked him to repeat and named the letter order; he fixed at 43:16.
The subject of kaan is 3umr (masculine), not 'she', so it is kaan 3umurha; he pushed كانت twice (43:36, 43:43) and Amal said لأ، كان عمرها صح.
rows.english: when she was (her age was) twelve

rows.why: He said eleven for the twelve in her sentence (sheet: twelve | tna3sh); Amal gave إتناش and he repeated it at 44:18; may be a memory slip of the prompt rather than a word error.

byinkeser is the huwwe form; for heyye it is btinkeser; Amal prompted 'هو' (that's the he-form) and he fixed: هي بتنكسر (45:46). His 45:24 هو بينكسري (ي ending on the he-form) went by with her 'إنتو' only.

rows.medi_said: air condition-ي، air conditioner-ي. Do I say for air condition?
rows.why: A borrowed English noun takes 'my' with taba3i, not the -i ending; he tried the ending and asked, Amal gave the taba3i form and he used it at 48:31 and 53:14.

rows.amal_said: مم، here's the thing. If it's physically broke then it's this. If it's not working properly we'd need that other word if you remember it.
rows.why: inkasar is only physical breaking; 'the AC stopped working' is 5ereb / 5arbaan; Amal prompted for the other word and he produced خربان (48:58); he tried إن كسر من الحرارة again at 49:28 and she repeated the point (one row).

rows.medi_said: بكسور-- بكسر، أنا ما بكسر، اشي، ... Never broken anything.
rows.amal_said: بكسر أو كسرت؟ ... The only thing with أبداً is the consistent thing is ما.
rows.why: 'I have never broken anything' is past (ma kasart); he used the present and argued abadan forces present; Amal prompted 'بكسر أو كسرت؟', explained abadan only needs ma, and he fixed to أنا أبدًا ما كسرت ولا اشي.
Letters swapped again (sakkart = I closed) for kasart; Amal recast and he repeated كسرت at 52:44.
'I didn't sleep well' negates the verb with ma; he negated the adverb with mish; Amal recast with 'Or' (may be offering the better form rather than ruling his wrong) and he repeated ما نِمِت منيح.

rows.medi_said: إن إن. الفـ--، الفـ--، علات، الفعلات إن.
rows.why: Plural of fe3el is the broken plural af3aal; he invented fe3laat with -aat; Amal recast and he said الأفعال.

For 'I am annoyed' he said muz3ej (annoying); the sheet lists them as two words (annoyed | Maz3ooj | مزعوج; annoying | Muz3ej | مزعج); he said 'No.' but gave no right word before Amal supplied مزعوج, and then confirmed مزعج = annoying.

rows.medi_said: is it بزور بنكسر؟ بنكسر. أكسر. Okay.
rows.why: Naming the last pair he gave the bare akser for 'I break'; Amal restated بكسر and بنكسر; low because he was listing, not using, the verb.
